own_solution.law: Vertical motion obeys vy = v sin(theta) and H = h_launch + vy²/(2g). The vertical rise is (20 sin 40°)²/(2 × 9.8) = 8.43216 m. A stand supporting the platform adds its height to h_launch. Ball mass cancels between vertical kinetic energy and gravitational potential energy.
assumptions: Gravity is uniform with magnitude 9.8 m/s².
The platform alone contributes 5 m to the launch height; a stand installed beneath it for the current launch adds its height.
The ceiling does not obstruct the trajectory when it is above the unobstructed apex.

T4C78.regime: Ceiling height q exceeds the unobstructed apex H = 13.43216 m. All listed values, 18, 26 and 43 m, satisfy H < q.
